row.evidence: Judge.me's help centre says "We don't have separate user accounts within Judge.me"; team members get access by being added as Shopify store users with the Judge.me Reviews app permission.
row.notes: Shopify reviews app with no user accounts of its own: access is inherited from Shopify staff accounts and roles (Settings > Users > Roles > App permissions), so user lifecycle is handled in Shopify, not in Judge.me. Pricing is flat per store, monthly: Free $0 and Awesome $15/mo; per-user fields null. The public REST API (https://judge.me/api/v1) covers reviews and review requests only, no user management. No Okta OIN page or Entra gallery tutorial found.

scim.notes: No SCIM: Judge.me has no separate user accounts; team access comes from Shopify staff permissions.

limitations.text: API covers store review data (reviews, review requests, widgets); no user, group or role endpoints, since Judge.me has no separate user accounts.

user_api.notes: A REST API exists for reviews (https://judge.me/api/v1, private API token) but Judge.me has no user accounts, so there is no user-management API.
